Hi all — attaching the checklist and the inventory file. Notes below summarize evidence items and where to find exports.

Summary (high level):
- Attachment: redwood_validation_checklist_20260811.pdf — our internal vendor-change checklist with required artifacts and sign-off columns.
- Attachment: subprocessor_inventory_v2.csv — row for NetRoute flagged with "pending swap" and effective date 2026-08-18.

Key data export/data path details (short):
1) Inference request path: customer -> Redwood Edge Gateway (regional) -> inference runtime (GPU pool). Edge proxy (NetRoute) sits only in the control plane for routing; it does not persist customer content. Payloads are forwarded and transiently buffered (in-memory) during connection; no write-to-disk by default.
2) Telemetry & logs: aggregated metrics and anonymized telemetry routed to our observability provider (LogKeep) — NetRoute will forward only flow logs required for health/ingress; those logs contain no customer prompt/response payloads. Retention: we keep flow logs for 30 days by default; we can set a 24-hour retention window for the maintenance window.
3) Cross-border flows: NetRoute operates egress points in US, EU (Frankfurt), and APAC (Tokyo). For customers whose tenancy is pinned to EU, routing policy will prefer the Frankfurt egress and we will configure NetRoute to avoid US egress for pinned accounts.

Evidence location and items we can provide:
- SOC 2 Type II attestation PDF (LogKeep and NetRoute) — stored in our GDrive vendor-evidence folder (link below).
- Network diagram (PNG) showing ingress/egress points and proposed routing policy (attached inline).
- Export logs sample (redacted) for previous deploys (CSV) — available on request.

Mitigations we propose for cutover:
- Pre-swap: full smoke tests in staging; 12-hour maintenance window and reduced retention for flow logs.
- During swap: enable IP allowlists, route EU-tenants to Frankfurt only, and ramp traffic via canary to 5% before full cutover.
- Rollback: fallback rule to route traffic back to EdgeBridge for any error threshold.

Attachments: redwood_validation_checklist_20260811.pdf; subprocessor_inventory_v2.csv; network_diagram_netroute_swap.png

Let me know if you need the SOC2 PDF or an exported sample of logs for data travel verification — I can prod Legal to share.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Contracts
Redwood Inference

[Attachments: redwood_validation_checklist_20260811.pdf (PDF), network_diagram_netroute_swap.png (PNG), subprocessor_inventory_v2.csv (CSV)]
